prompts.porcelain:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup. A complete new visual identity and information architecture for Timelens, a premium Windows desktop app for privately reviewing recorded application activity and time. Direction name: 白瓷时序. Do not print this direction name or any option number.
This is a clean-sheet redesign. The previous navy prototype and its horizontal maintenance button bar have been explicitly rejected. No old Timelens screenshot is attached because the user wants a new product design, not reskinning.

Target: ONE full-screen 1600 x 1000 desktop app concept, front-on and pixel-sharp. App UI only, no marketing page, collage, browser frame, desktop wallpaper, device or floating mockup background. A subtle integrated Windows title strip is allowed, with minimize/maximize/close on upper right; do not copy macOS traffic lights from the references.
Reference images: Notion Calendar's official desktop screen for three-column spatial clarity and fine calendar grid; Things' official Today screen for calm typography and information grouping. They are visual inspiration only, not content to clone. Preserve Timelens functionality, no tasks or meeting scheduler.

Hard structural constraint: exactly THREE full-height columns: 216px left navigation sidebar, an expansive 1016px central time-and-application workspace, 368px right context inspector. Only thin vertical dividers separate these contiguous surfaces. All original frontend layout details may change. No fourth panel. No large rounded cards wrapping each column. No KPI card grid.
Primary workflow: choose a day and time range, see which apps were used, inspect the selected app. The main area is a composed reading surface, not a settings console.

Visual direction: an exceptionally refined LIGHT desktop interface. Porcelain white #ffffff, very pale neutral gray sidebar #f5f5f3, almost-white right panel #fcfcfb, deep charcoal text #252725, secondary text #777c78. One desaturated forest-jade accent #477562, with subtle pale sage #e9f0eb for selection. Restrained dusty violet, soft clay and slate can differentiate application activity but occupy little area. No navy, electric blue, gradients, glass, glow, drop-shadow card stacks or ornamental visuals. Use thin warm-gray rules, exact baseline alignment, mostly flat surfaces. Body14–15px, auxiliary12–13px, page heading30px, one expressive32px duration. Typography like Inter/Segoe UI Variable with refined Simplified Chinese sans. Generous margins, controlled density, not huge empty regions. Tiny consistent monochrome Lucide-style icons, never emoji.

Date anchor: Saturday 2026-09-05, Asia/Shanghai. Visible date heading “9月5日” with “星期六 · 2026” nearby. Selected range 09:00–18:00. No incorrect weekday/date combinations.
Left sidebar: a small elegant clock-like mark and mixed-case wordmark “Timelens”, plenty of breathing room. Below, “时间线” selected in a quiet rounded sage row, then “应用”, “快照”, “统计与报告”, “AI 总结”. Consistent icon and label alignments. Lower sidebar shows a compact September 2026 date picker with Saturday the 5th selected; the week starts Monday (August31, Sep1,2,3,4,5,6 correct). Bottom separated from navigation: “已暂停记录” with a subtle resume control, and “设置”. No account avatar, subscription upsell, workspace management, database paths or developer IDs.
Center top: modest breadcrumb “时间线”, then the date heading and clean day-navigation controls. On the same top band a compact “今天” control, date arrows, and one dark-jade action “生成总结”. Next row: “09:00—18:00”, view choices “日 / 周” with 日 selected, and a compact “查找应用” input.
Center content: an impeccably drawn horizontal application swimlane timeline on a WHITE surface, with axis ticks 09:00 through 18:00, fine hour rules, rows labeled Visual Studio Code, Obsidian, Microsoft Edge, 文件资源管理器. Treat the chart itself as the hero. App names sit in a narrow label gutter, time bars lie across the remaining width, no miniature unreadable charts. Use carefully rounded 4px interval blocks with mostly subtle translucent color and solid selected interval. Selected Visual Studio Code row has pale sage emphasis.
Mock recorded focus segments, chronologically correct, nonoverlapping across apps: VS Code 09:00–10:34 and 14:10–15:22 (2小时46分 total); Obsidian 10:45–11:30 and 16:07–16:40 (1小时18分); Edge 11:30–12:10 and 15:22–15:44 (1小时02分); Explorer 17:00–17:18 (18分). A narrow amber hatched gap at 13:00–13:17 is labeled “记录缺口 17 分钟”. Do not invent productivity scores, goals, client names, document titles or website contents.
Below the timeline, a short elegantly aligned summary strip: “聚焦 5小时24分”, “4 个应用”, “已记录 8小时43分”, without separate metric cards. Then a simple selected-day application table with column headers “应用 / 聚焦时长 / 窗口”, four rows using those same durations, VS Code selected and 3 windows; other counts 1,2,1. A restrained footer “记录仅保存在本机” may sit below the table. No maintenance buttons on this screen.
Right inspector: header “应用详情” with a tiny more menu. A small VS Code app mark, “Visual Studio Code” and “今日 · 09:00—18:00”. One prominent “2小时46分” with the label “聚焦时长”. Under a thin divider, a clean definition list with “打开 5小时32分”, “显示 4小时05分”, “后台 1小时27分”, “键盘 12,486 次”, “鼠标 328 次”. Next section “窗口 · 3” lists “窗口 1 / 窗口 2 / 窗口 3” with a subtle disclosure, no fabricated document names. At the bottom, two quiet contextual links “查看相关快照” and “生成本地报告”. Avoid duplicating the large chart in this narrow inspector.

Fit the entire composition naturally into 1600x1000. This must look ready for a public product launch: a coherent visual identity, clear information architecture, sophisticated hierarchy, perfect alignment and spacing. All Chinese copy must be readable; no clipped controls, no repeating technical badges, no dashboard template aesthetic.
prompts.paper:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup. Full clean-sheet Timelens redesign for a premium, publicly releasable Windows desktop time-history product.
Direction name: 羊皮纸手记. Do not print the name or any option number on the image.
The user's previous dark-navy developer prototype was rejected. Invent a wholly new product expression, preserving ONLY a left navigation sidebar and a three-column structure. Do not produce another dashboard recolor.

ONE complete 1600 x 1000 desktop screen. Flat app UI only, no presentation board, outer scene, browser chrome, device body, wallpaper, giant marketing hero, or decorative stock photography. Integrated native Windows minimize/maximize/close at the top-right; no Mac traffic lights.
Reference images: Things official Today page is inspiration for reading rhythm, clear grouping and spacious type; Notion Calendar official desktop frame is inspiration for three-column composition. Borrow their product discipline, not their content or logos.

Three contiguous full-height columns: 224px left navigation, 986px central chronological activity reading area, 390px right detail panel. No extra navigation rail and no fourth column. Major surfaces meet at fine vertical rules, not rounded cards floating on a background.
Art direction: sophisticated WARM LIGHT interface inspired by a well-made paper planner translated into native software. Ivory canvas #faf8f4, slightly darker oat sidebar #f1eee7, right inspector #f6f2ec, warm ink #322e29. A quiet terracotta #ac6648 for selected state and one primary action, fine sepia-gray lines #e4ddd3, readable muted labels #81766a. Subtle dusty lavender and olive may identify apps but should not dominate. No blue/navy surfaces, glossy gradients, glass, glow, oversized rounded boxes or faux paper texture. This is crisp contemporary software with understated editorial warmth.
Typography: exceptional Chinese sans-serif legibility, 15px body, 12–13px auxiliary, 30px page heading, beautiful tabular durations. Date and section headings can have a small amount of elegant typographic expression; avoid decorative calligraphy or excessive serif text. Use at most two typefaces. Spacing should feel intentional and relaxed, with exactly aligned time, application name and duration columns. Monochrome fine-line icons, no emoji or doodles.

Date: Saturday 2026-09-05 in Asia/Shanghai. The page heading says “9月5日” and “星期六”. The chosen range is “09:00—18:00”. Date navigation shows a compact seven-day strip “8/31 一, 9/1 二, 9/2 三, 9/3 四, 9/4 五, 9/5 六, 9/6 日” with Saturday5 selected in terracotta.
Sidebar: small clock-like mark and mixed-case “Timelens”. Main navigation “时间线” active, then “应用”, “快照”, “统计与报告”, “AI 总结”, using a calm active row, generous vertical spacing and aligned icons. Lower left has “已暂停记录”, a subtle “继续记录” button and “设置”. Do not put retention, clear-all, database information, connection settings, teams or subscription controls in the main screen.

Center structure:
A refined top header with breadcrumb 时间线 and date, discreet date arrows/今天, and one terracotta “生成总结” action. Under it the seven-day strip, then a compact summary sentence “聚焦 5小时24分 · 4 个应用” and the range 09:00—18:00. No metric card row.
The main surface is a beautifully designed chronological reading list, not a repeated chart/table dashboard. Time labels form a slim left gutter, a very fine connecting rule organizes the day, and application activities occupy the broad reading column. Each entry has a small real app identity icon, clear application name, duration on the far right and exact interval in readable smaller text. Entries are simple flat rows with thoughtful spacing, never cards inside cards, no checkbox/task widgets.
Chronological entries:
“上午” section.
09:00 Visual Studio Code — “09:00–10:34” — “1小时34分”.
10:45 Obsidian — “10:45–11:30” — “45分”.
11:30 Microsoft Edge — “11:30–12:10” — “40分”.
A small inset amber separator at “13:00–13:17 · 记录缺口 17 分钟”, clearly showing missing records rather than downtime.
“下午” section.
14:10 Visual Studio Code — “14:10–15:22” — “1小时12分”. This one is selected with a very subtle terracotta-tinted background and thin accent edge.
15:22 Microsoft Edge — “15:22–15:44” — “22分”.
16:07 Obsidian — “16:07–16:40” — “33分”.
17:00 文件资源管理器 — “17:00–17:18” — “18分”.
Keep all seven activities and the gap readable in the viewport using disciplined 52–56px row spacing. Do not invent document titles, websites, personal tasks, productivity scores, projects, notes or meeting contents. Activities are recorded application focus intervals, not appointments the user plans.
A very slim, unobtrusive day overview bar can sit near the center bottom as a navigation aid, followed by the small status “已记录 8小时43分”. Avoid adding a second large visualization.

Right inspector: contextual title “时段详情”, small application logo and “Visual Studio Code”; compact date “9月5日 · 14:10—15:22”. One elegant prominent “1小时12分” with label “本次聚焦”. Then two precise definition rows “开始 14:10” / “结束 15:22”. A fine separator followed by “应用今日汇总” and “聚焦 2小时46分”, “打开 5小时32分”, “显示 4小时05分”, “后台 1小时27分”. Another small group “键盘 12,486 次” and “鼠标 328 次”, clearly scoped to today's app total. A “窗口 · 3” section with neat three window rows, no fictional filenames. At the bottom contextual text actions “查看相关快照” and “生成本地报告”. Do not display an invented screenshot preview or arbitrary image.

This design should feel human, deliberate and complete: the experience of looking back over a day is the hero. Maintain a strong left-to-right hierarchy, avoid excessive boxed sections, make Chinese text precise and numbers consistent, and never regress into the old developer-console style.
